abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine whether a testicular self-examination-based early-detection program may help in the early diagnosis of testicular cancer. METHODS: Advertisements were placed in the media describing the early signs of testicular cancer, the risk factors, the correct method of self-examination and the importance of early detection. Between April 1995 and April 1998, 5,056 men underwent physical and ultrasound examination of the testicles, and in case of suspicious findings tumor markers were checked. RESULTS: Testicular tumors were found in 1.28% of the men with symptoms. No tumors were found in men without symptoms or in men with pain, sensitivity to palpation, or complaints unrelated to the testicle. Of those with a palpable lump or swollen testicle, 4.5 and 3.9% were found to have a tumor. In total, 28 testicular cancers (15 seminomas and 13 nonseminomas) in 26 volunteers and 4 benign tumors were detected. The occurrence of cancer was most frequent in the age group of 15--40 years (1.6%). CONCLUSION: The rate of cancer detection and the detected seminoma rate in the program are not sufficient to justify a widespread early detection program for testicular cancer (examination of men who reveal testicular abnormalities by self-examination) despite the increased tumor incidence. Early diagnosis should be based on an educational program for the population at risk, the training of staff engaged in the health care of the young, and the use of early ultrasound examination in men with palpable lumps and swollen testicles, especially in young men.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣自己触診に基づく早期発見プログラムが、精巣がんの早期診断に役立つかどうかを検討すること。方法：媒体で広告を掲載し、精巣がんの早期徴候、危険因子、正しい自己触診法、早期発見の重要性を伝えた。1995年4月から1998年4月の間に、5,056名が精巣の身体診察と超音波検査を受けた。疑わしい所見があった場合は腫瘍マーカーを測定した。結果：有症状の男性の1.28%に精巣腫瘍が見つかった。無症状の男性、圧痛や疼痛のある男性、精巣と無関係な症状の男性では腫瘍は認められなかった。触知可能なしこりまたは腫大した精巣を有する男性では、それぞれ4.5%と3.9%に腫瘍が認められた。合計で、ボランティア26名から精巣がん28例（セミノーマ15例、非セミノーマ13例）と良性腫瘍4例が検出された。がんの発生は15〜40歳の年齢層で最も多く（1.6%）であった。結論：腫瘍の発見率およびセミノーマの検出率は、精巣異常を自己触診で見つけた男性を対象とする精巣がんの広範な早期発見プログラムを正当化するには不十分であった。若年男性を中心に、リスク集団への教育プログラム、医療従事者の訓練、触知可能なしこりや腫大精巣を有する男性に対する早期超音波検査に基づくべきである。
